analysis: The PR change in this batch is documentation-only: CHANGELOG.md adds a bullet under 'Unreleased — provider 0.9.17' (patch lines 6-10). The bullet says an explicitly configured TMPDIR is now honored for anonymous runtime metallib snapshots, with unlink-before-copy and digest binding preserved and no fallback when an explicit directory is invalid or unwritable. No source code is supplied, so the TMPDIR behavior itself was not reviewed. Security-relevant points a later pass should check if source appears: (1) the metallib snapshot location moves to a user-controlled TMPDIR, so check that it is a private directory with no symlink or TOCTOU race, that digest binding is verified after copy, and that unlink-before-copy holds; this relates to T-013 and T-034 (provider code integrity) and to TB-003 (operator vs process, where the operator is the adversary and already controls their own TMPDIR). (2) The T-041 SSD cache does not appear related. The changelog change itself introduces no security regression and does not invalidate any threat-model assumption. Because the source implementing the TMPDIR change is not in this batch, coverage is limited to the changelog text and nothing is concluded about the implementation. Patch hunk line placement looks like a minor formatting oddity (the new bullet is placed before a blank line), which is not security relevant.
